raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "adopt"
  role subject "Senate"
  role object "the revised academic misconduct regulations"
  role time "14 May"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "circulate"
  role subject "the Registrar"
  role object "minutes from the Education Committee"
  role time "late April"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "the paper trail"
  role object "minutes from the Education Committee"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@q query
  where match
    relation "be approved"
    role subject "the minutes that were circulated by the Registrar"
    role time ?t
    polarity affirmed
  end
  order ?t before "14 May"
